classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: Service class providing maintenance-related functionalities including retrieving purgeable entities, managing access strategies, and data extraction for employee privacy compliance.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Reads a YAML configuration file to retrieve a list of entities that can be purged, caching the result for subsequent calls.

methods.name: getAccessStrategy
methods.description: Instantiates and returns an access strategy object based on provided strategy name and info.

methods.name: accessEmployeeData
methods.description: Retrieves data related to an employee's GDPR compliance by executing access strategies within a database transaction.

methods.name: getMaintenanceDao
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an instance of MaintenanceDao.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Delegates data extraction to MaintenanceDao based on employee number and table.
